title: thalictrum gallicum subsp. silaifolium
intro: Thalictrum gallicum subsp. silaifolium, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and alleviate pain. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
